study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Meijer et al., Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Toward Understanding Autism Heterogeneity: Identifying Clinical Subgroups and Neuroanatomical Deviations

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Combine data-driven clinical subgrouping with normative modeling of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes to test whether reducing clinical heterogeneity increases neuroanatomical homogeneity and improves ASD classification.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The study explicitly states that both ABIDE I and ABIDE II repositories were combined for all analyses.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: We combined the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) repositories I ... and II ... for all the analyses conducted in the present study.

rci2_hc_n.reason: After exclusions, the normative modeling analysis included 744 non-autistic individuals (NAI).
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 non-autistic individuals between 5-64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis.

rci3_hc_age.answer: min 5; max 64; mean NR; sd NR
rci3_hc_age.reason: Only the overall age range is reported; mean and SD for healthy controls are not provided.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: N autism = 861, N nonautistic individuals [N NAI] = 886, age range = 5-64 ... normative modeling (N autism = 690, N NAI = 744)

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Primary analyses excluded females due to scarce availability; the normative modeling sample counts imply male-only NAI.
rci4_hc_sex.supporting_text: For primary analyses, we excluded female participants due to scarce availability across sites (N autism=130, N NAI=280)... This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 non-autistic individuals ... included in the normative modeling analysis.

rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: We processed the T1-weighted images from the ABIDE datasets using the FreeSurfer software (Version 7.3.2).

rci6_analysis_level.supporting_text: CT was extracted ... using the Destrieux parcellation ... 74 regions in each hemisphere ... A separate normative model was built for each of the 148 CT ROIs and 23 subcortical ROIs independently.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: FreeSurfer v7.3.2; Destrieux parcellation; FreeSurfer subcortical volume-based stream; MNI305 registration; B1 bias field correction
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Detailed FreeSurfer-based pipeline with parcellation and subcortical labeling is described.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: FreeSurfer software (Version 7.3.2) ... CT ... Destrieux parcellation ... volume-based stream ... affine registration with MNI305 ... B1 bias field intensity correction ... volumewas labeled (Fischl et al., 2002).

rci9_quality_checking_detail.answer: Visual QC plus Euler number threshold (exclude Euler < -300); excluded low-quality images (autism N=15; NAI N=7) and corrupted preprocessing (e.g., CT=0).
rci9_quality_checking_detail.reason: Threshold and numbers of excluded participants are reported; method aligns with prior ABIDE studies.
rci9_quality_checking_detail.supporting_text: participants who had low image quality as assessed by both visual inspection and the Euler number ... we excluded individuals with values smaller than -300 ... participants with cortical thickness (CT) values of zero (N autism=4, N NAI=1)

rci11_site_effect_handling_detail.answer: Warped Bayesian linear regression (PCNtoolkit) with site as a fixed covariate; ensured balanced age/FIQ/site distributions between train/test; merged sites with similar protocols across ABIDE I/II.
rci11_site_effect_handling_detail.reason: Method and covariates explicitly listed; balancing and site merging described; no ComBat used.
rci11_site_effect_handling_detail.supporting_text: Here, we performed normative modeling ... included age, site, FIQ, and quality measures ... We ensured that age, FIQ, and site were evenly distributed across the training and test sets. Sites with same/highly similar imaging acquisition protocols were merged ...

caa6_deviation_metric.reason: Z-scores from normative models used to quantify deviations; threshold and overlap defined.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Group-based permutation tests with FDR correction on spatial overlap maps; SVM classification using deviation Z-scores; performance metrics reported (Accuracy ~0.61–0.77, Balanced accuracy ~0.65–0.66, AUC ~0.69–0.70).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Two clinical subgroups primarily differing in RRBs showed increased homogeneity in localized neuroanatomical deviations (cerebellar volume increases in high-RRB; decreased CT in postcentral/fusiform in low-RRB), but classifier performance did not improve, indicating substantial residual heterogeneity.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Subgrouping increased localized overlap of deviations: high-RRB subgroup showed increased subcortical volume deviations in the cerebellum; low-RRB subgroup showed decreased CT deviations in postcentral gyrus and fusiform cortex. Despite this, SVM classification accuracy did not improve when distinguishing subgroups from NAI (Accuracy 0.61–0.77; Balanced accuracy 0.65–0.66; AUC 0.69–0.70; Table S2).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Sensitivity analysis controlled FDR per NPM; ensured balanced age/FIQ/site distributions between train/test; merged similar-protocol sites across ABIDE I/II.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Female participants were excluded; despite subgrouping, substantial within-group heterogeneity remained and classification performance did not improve, limiting immediate clinical separability.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Site merging across ABIDE I/II (KKI, NYU_1, SDSU, UCLA_1) to increase per-site N; Euler < -300 exclusion; models trained per-ROI; training = 90% NAI; test = all ASD + 10% NAI.
